description: Set the session's live viewport size (CSS pixels). The console calls this as its browser pane resizes so the streamed frame fills the pane with no letterboxing and clicks map 1:1; the device toolbar calls it with a preset. Clamped 200..4000. mobile=true emulates a phone (touch input, an Android Chrome user agent); reload once when mode_changed.

fit.description: Mark this resize as a pane auto-fit; a fit is refused (current size returned) while more than one viewer watches the session.

mobile.description: Emulate a phone: the mobile viewport (viewport meta, overlay scrollbars), touch input (`navigator.maxTouchPoints`, `(pointer: coarse)`, an `act` left click arrives as a tap) and an Android Chrome user agent with matching client hints. Default false, which restores the desktop browser. The user agent reaches the page on its next load: reload once when `mode_changed`. The device toolbar sets this for phone presets.
The emulation now in force: true for a phone, false for the desktop browser. A fit that was refused or only grown (several viewers) keeps the mode the tab had.

mode_changed.description: True when this call switched between phone and desktop; the page sees the other user agent only after it loads again.
